rows.corpus_definition: A person who teaches a specific skill or sport.
rows.example_en: My yoga instructor is very patient.

rows.corpus_definition: To say something mean to make someone feel bad.
rows.example_en: It is rude to insult your friends in public.

rows.corpus_definition: a rude or hurtful remark that makes someone feel disrespected
rows.example_en: She walked away rather than respond to the insult.

rows.corpus_definition: To talk or do things with other people.
rows.example_en: It is fun to interact with other students.

rows.corpus_definition: To stop someone while they are speaking or doing something.
rows.example_en: Please do not interrupt while I am working.

rows.corpus_definition: The first part of a book or a meeting of new people.
rows.example_en: The book has a very short introduction.

rows.corpus_definition: to enter a country by force, as an enemy
rows.example_en: The army invaded the small country at dawn.

rows.corpus_definition: To have someone or something as a necessary part.
rows.example_en: The job will involve traveling to other cities.

rows.corpus_definition: to be a part of an activity or group.
rows.example_en: He is involved in several sports clubs.

rows.corpus_definition: to make someone feel slightly angry or annoyed
rows.example_en: The constant noise began to irritate the neighbours.

rows.corpus_definition: An uncomfortable feeling on the skin that makes you want to scratch.
rows.example_en: My mosquito bite has a terrible itch.
